liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sing Me Back Home** (2 reviews): Reviewer played Sing Me Back Home several times and likes the Not Fade Away > Goin' Down the Road > Not Fade Away sequence; Garcia sounds beautiful on Sing Me Back Home, a song that had developed a lot in a short time [9][15]
- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer guesses the short film clip may be of Deal and Hard to Handle from the first set [5]
- **Hard to Handle** (1 review): Solid version, though reviewer ranks it below the 4-29-71 Fillmore East and 8-6-71 Hollywood Bowl performances [4]

## The recordings

- **gd71-04-24.sbd.lai.2579.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 134 min; rated 4.44/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls it a great-sounding soundboard; Reviewer says the soundboard recording quality is excellent, with a classic 1971 sound; Reviewer calls it a nice recording [1][7][8][9][15]
- **gd1971-04-24.143959.sbd.boswell.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 133 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1971-04-24.143958.sbd.boswell.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: soundboard; 20 songs; 133 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Only concert footage in a black-and-white film of the 1971 tour comes from this show; a scoreboard reading Duke and Visitors is visible [5]
- Reviewer says the band played tight and the jams were very good [6]
- Reviewer describes the band's playing as rough, aggressive and down-and-dirty rather than polished, not an especially amazing concert [7]
- Attendee says the day ran about 12 hours: Mountain, then the Dead, then the Beach Boys closing [10]
- Attendee recalls Phil or Jerry telling the crowd they had never shared a bill with the Beach Boys [10]
- Reviewer suggests three bands on the bill explains the relatively short second set [15]
- Hard to Handle here is not quite as strong as the Fillmore East 4-29-71 and Hollywood Bowl 8-6-71 versions [4]
- Beach Boys joined the Dead onstage at Fillmore East on April 27, three days later, during their five-night run [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-04-24.sbd.lai.2579.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai and Michael K Weise; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Casey Jones was moved from disc 2 to disc 1; md5 signatures are unchanged though file names differ [1]
- **gd1971-04-24.143959.sbd.boswell.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Will Boswell and Matt Smith; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Matt Smith; source: Master 7" 1/2 track Soundboard Reels @ 7.5 ips > Will Boswell's Reels > Matt Smith's 2nd generation Reels [2]. Also: Source and transfer by Matt Smith, coordinated by Charlie Miller; this version lacks the dropouts found on shnid 2579 [2]
- **gd1971-04-24.143958.sbd.boswell.smith.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Will Boswell and Matt Smith; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Matt Smith; source: Master 7" 1/2 track Soundboard Reels @ 7.5 ips > Will Boswell's Reels > Matt Smith's 2nd generation Reels [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1971-04-24 Sat Joe College Weekend Wallace Wade Stadium, Duke University, Durham, NC](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1481910680110/grateful-dead-1971-04-24-sat-joe-college) [17]
